appStore.name: Sual Arena: Islamic Quiz
appStore.subtitle: Family trivia & live duels
appStore.promotionalText: Live duels, the "Don't Say It!" family game, 5 fresh questions every day and the Ramadan League. Test your knowledge with your loved ones.
appStore.description:
Sual Arena is a respectful, fun Islamic knowledge game you can play with the people you love.

GAME MODES
• Duel: A live one-on-one match. 5 questions, 10 seconds each; fast answers earn bonus points. If no opponent is found you play a clearly labelled BOT.
• Friends Room: Create a private room with a 6-digit code and play with 2-8 people.
• Don't Say It!: A family game on a single phone, no internet needed. Pass the phone around and explain the word without saying the forbidden ones. Two teams, adjustable timer and levels for every age.
• Daily Question: The same 5 questions for everyone, every day. Keep your streak and share your result as an emoji grid.
• Ramadan League: During Ramadan, a special set opens every day after iftar, with a Night of Power finale. The season opens in Ramadan.

TOPICS
Quran, the Prophet's life (Seerah), stories of the prophets, Islamic history, basics of faith and practice, and Arabic words.

TRUSTWORTHY AND RESPECTFUL CONTENT
Questions are written with sources and reviewed by a human editor before they are published. We avoid topics disputed between schools of thought. If you spot a mistake, use "Report a problem" on any question. There is no chat between users; only ready-made emoji reactions.

LANGUAGES
Turkish, Arabic (full right-to-left) and English interface.

FREE AND PREMIUM
The free version includes 10 duels per day and shows ads. Premium removes ads, unlocks all categories and all Don't Say It! decks, and makes duels unlimited. Signing in is optional; you can play as a guest.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Premium is offered as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, or as a one-time lifetime option. Payment is charged to your account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically at the same price and length unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your account settings.

Terms of Use: https://sual-arena.netlify.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://sual-arena.netlify.app/privacy
